source_set: Bloom Protocol / direction v3 / safe-1610 (HUD inside the 16:10 cover crop)
copy_policy: Stills retain exact source bytes, following source symlinks; no image edits. Intros are quality-targeted H.264 re-encodes; source_sha256 identifies each original and sha256 identifies the shipped encode.

intro_encoding.quality_target: Full-clip mean VMAF >= 95 against the source; CRF 22, reduced to 21 where needed. Grain retained without denoising. Lossy, not pixel-identical.
intro_encoding.command: ffmpeg -i SOURCE -map 0:v:0 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf CRF -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 6 -movflags +faststart OUTPUT
